callees.name: self._console.write
callees.pre_condition: The console stream is open. data is a str.
callees.post_condition: The string data is written to the console stream. Returns the number of characters written.

callees.name: self._log_stream.write
callees.pre_condition: The log stream is open (not closed). data is a str.
callees.post_condition: The string data is written to the log stream. Returns the number of characters written.
